title: Israel Wants a King
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm, grateful heart, and tonight Israel wants a king just because everyone else has one: Willow wants her friend's shiny shoes until she remembers what her own old shoes have done.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because a warm, grateful heart is the cure for wanting what everybody else has. In Willow’s world today: her friend comes to school in sparkly new light-up shoes, and suddenly Willow’s own shoes look old and plain. All day she wants light-up shoes too. At bedtime she looks at her scuffed shoes by the door. They ran her fastest race. They splashed in her favorite puddle. They walked her to Grandma’s house. Willow smiles and says thank you to Heavenly Father for them. Just like Israel with their King, Willow learned that she already had more than she noticed.
